decision.explanation: Both documents D1S3/D1S4 and D2S3/D2S4 independently assert that the 24th Rifle Division was formed in 1918 and 1920 respectively, with subsequent renaming to the 24th Simbirsk Rifle Division in November of those years. These are distinct valid answers referring to the same unit under different formation dates according to separate sources. Neither is contradicted by the full context, and both are directly relevant to the question.
